Title: Still dragging after a full night's sleep? Check these 3 habits

Description:
Chronic low energy can build up with no diagnosed condition at all. Running low on water, falling short on magnesium, and scrolling on a bright phone before bed can each quietly wreck your energy the next day — even after eight hours in bed.

Watch to see why each one matters and what to swap in instead.

#chronicfatigue #dehydration #magnesium #sleepquality #healthtips #wellness

Still dragging even after a full night's sleep? 😴

Running low on water, falling short on magnesium, and scrolling on a bright phone before bed — three habits that quietly wreck your energy the next day.

Carry a water bottle, add magnesium-rich foods like spinach or almonds, and put the phone down an hour before bed.
